job.question: In the Q&A for an external audit RFP for a retirement system whose general ledger system is Microsoft Dynamics SL, what were the total contractual fees for the prior year (FY2021) audits?
job.expected_facts: $73,000 (Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System, RFP 515-22-300 Q&A).
job.acceptance: $73,000 for FY2021 audits suffices; issuer/RFP number optional.

reviews.reason: This is a 2017 Hawaii ERS private-equity consulting RFP, not a Q&A for an external audit RFP. It provides no FY2021 audit-fee information.
